ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low contrast ratio across the main fluke surface; the distribution is heavily skewed toward low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to <3% of the total visible area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central notch with an estimated interior angle of approximately 35 to 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing edge; visible jagged topography with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 4-12 pixels throughout the length of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curve leading to sharply pointed, upward-sweeping distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular white pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular trailing edge morphology consistent with accumulated physical wear; a significant notch or missing section of pixel data at the upper-right distal tip.
